notes: DRAFT. Customer-phrased questions: each describes the need without the poster's own terms, to test retrieval on paraphrase. Expected answers must be checked by the owner before any score is reported.
avoids lists the poster terms the question deliberately does not use.
Questions where two sections hold different correct answers were left out, because each question is scored against one expected section.
Same fields and scoring rules as eval/questions.json.

questions.question: How much does it cost to send money to another bank through an agent?
questions.expected_answer: Ksh.20 for amounts above Ksh 1,000; free (Ksh.0) for 0-1,000. Agency charges do not include excise duty.

questions.question: I want to take out 8,000 bob at a shop that does Co-op banking. What will they charge me?
How much will I pay to check how much money I have left when I'm at an agent?
Does it cost anything to put cash into my account at an agent?
questions.expected_answer: No. Cash deposits at an agent are free for all amounts.

questions.question: What does an agent charge me to pay my electricity bill?
My Platinum credit card got lost. How much do I pay to get a new one?
questions.expected_answer: Ksh.1000 for a Platinum card replacement, per occurrence.

questions.question: Is there a penalty if I spend more than my credit card allows?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. An over limit fee of Ksh.1000 per occurrence.

questions.question: If I only pay part of my credit card bill, how much extra do I pay on what is left?
questions.expected_answer: 3.5% of the revolved (unpaid) balance per month.

questions.question: What does it cost to get cash out using my credit card?
questions.expected_answer: A cash advance fee of 6% of the amount accessed, per occurrence. Deliberately hard: agency cash withdrawal rows are a tempting wrong match.

questions.question: Do I pay for text message notifications on my credit card?
How much money do I need to start a dollar account?
questions.expected_answer: USD 10, for both current and savings accounts.

questions.question: Will I be charged for shutting down my euro savings account?
I wrote a cheque from my dollar current account by mistake. How much to cancel it before it is paid?
questions.expected_answer: USD 4 (stop payment on a USD current account).

questions.question: Someone overseas is sending me money. Will the bank charge me to receive it?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. Incoming SWIFT payments are charged Ksh.500 plus excise duty.

questions.question: Is tax added on top of the bank's charges?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. Excise duty applies to all fees, charges and commissions.
